description.value: You were designed to be a surgeon, nurse, or battlefield medic, or were otherwise tasked with caring for the health of organic beings. You're familiar with the anatomical structure of many types of organic creatures and the sorts of illnesses, diseases, and injuries they're vulnerable to. You become trained in Medicine. If you would automatically become trained in Medicine (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Battle Medicine] skill feat.
